# Spinnaker Pediatric Dentistry

> Spinnaker Pediatric Dentistry in Salem, Oregon provides comprehensive pediatric dental care using advanced technology including laser dentistry, silver diamine fluoride, and digital crowns.

Led by Dr. Sean Cooper, Spinnaker Pediatric Dentistry specializes in creating positive first dental experiences for children through evidence-based techniques like Tell, Show, Do. The practice emphasizes preventive care, modern dental technology, and patient-centered treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Laser Dentistry
- Silver Diamine Fluoride
- Dental Crowns
- Preventive Care
- Fluoride Treatment
- Infant Dental Care
- Tell, Show, Do Approach

- Salem, Oregon

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://spinpedo.com/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services including crowns, sealants, and fluoride treatments
- [Laser Dentistry](https://spinpedo.com/laser-dentistry): Laser dentistry treatments for cavities, pulp therapy, and frenectomy
- [Your Child's First Visit](https://spinpedo.com/childs-first-visit): Guide to child's first dental visit and Tell, Show, Do approach
